data.name: Ashham
data.gender_notes: Ashham is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashham is the name derived from the Arabic word 'ashhama' which means 'to atone' or 'to make amends'. It is a name that is deeply rooted in the Islamic faith and signifies the act of seeking forgiveness and making reparations for past mistakes. The name Ashham carries the meaning “Atonement, Repentance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashham usually hope their child will grow to embody atonement, repentance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ashham is a reminder of the importance of seeking forgiveness and making amends for past mistakes in order to live a life in harmony with Allah.
data.etymology: Ashham belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Atonement, Repentance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashham total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
